description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods—labeled "Standard" and "Ours"—across three categories: "Base," "CORG," and a third category represented by a gray bar with no label. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 48 to 62, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 2. The "Standard" method is represented by a gray bar, and the "Ours" method is represented by a blue bar, with the blue bar stacked on top of the gray bar in the "CORG" and unlabeled category, indicating a combined or stacked measurement. In the "Base" category, the "Standard" method has a performance of approximately 60, while the "Ours" method is not visible, suggesting it is either zero or not applicable. In the "CORG" category, the "Standard" method has a performance of approximately 52, and the "Ours" method adds approximately 9, resulting in a total performance of about 61. In the unlabeled category, the "Standard" method has a performance of approximately 54, and the "Ours" method adds approximately 7, resulting in a total performance of about 61. The bars are sorted in descending order of total performance, with the "CORG" and unlabeled categories having higher total performance than the "Base" category. The chart uses a legend to distinguish between the two methods, with the "Standard" method represented by a gray color and the "Ours" method represented by a blue color.
